description: Download your checklist
excerpt: A friendly, step-by-step Smart Guide that helps you choose a project you’re truly ready to knit. Answer a few simple questions and get a confidence-boosting recommendation—plus the right Knit by Machine tools to get started.
metaTitle: Ready, Set, Knit: Project Planner | Knit by Machine Smart Guide
metaDescription: Not sure what to knit next? Use the Ready, Set, Knit Project Planner to choose a project that matches your time, yarn, machine, and confidence—then get guided to the perfect Knit by Machine resource.

schemaMarkup.name: Ready, Set, Knit: Project Planner
schemaMarkup.description: A friendly project-readiness Smart Guide that helps machine knitters choose a project based on their skills, time, yarn, and machine, and directs them to the appropriate Knit by Machine tool.

step.name: Choose your project direction
step.text: Begin by answering a few simple questions about what you want to knit next.

step.name: Share your experience and goals
step.text: Tell the guide how confident you feel, how long you've been machine knitting, and what you want from your project.

step.name: Provide details about your yarn and machine
step.text: Let the guide know what yarn you have and which machine you’ll be using.

step.name: Receive a personalized project recommendation
step.text: Based on your answers, the Smart Guide suggests a project you’re ready to knit and connects you to the right Knit by Machine resource.
